title: 결혼 전날, 가난한 남자가 약혼녀의 불륜을 목격하고 금전 갈취를 당한다.그 순간 시스템이 활성화된다. 불륜 적발 시 만 배 보상, 부자가 되어 인생 역전!
adapt: The hidden 'system' that activates at the moment of betrayal and pays out disproportionate reward maps directly onto an AI that silently detects deception/fraud and hands outsized power to whoever it favors.
why: Not literally about AI, but the 'dormant system suddenly grants judgment power' trope is a ready-made vessel for an AI story; undated fiction stays watchable indefinitely.

title: 가난한 소년이 시스템을 깨우고, 돈을 밝히는 여자를 꾸짖어 무한한 부를 얻고, 세계 최고의 부자가 된다.
adapt: An ordinary, dismissed person 'awakening' a system that then humbles the powerful and inverts the status hierarchy is the same shape as an underestimated AI capability suddenly overturning who holds power.
why: Fiction about a hidden system reversing power, not AI itself, but the awakening-power structure transfers cleanly; no dated references, so it stays relevant.
